meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 把项目的 claude-mem 时间线按 ISO 周拆成文件，然后逐周串行调用子代理，每周产出一章连载故事，上一周写好的交接块传给下一周，最终得到按周排列的多章摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline”等时触发；若只想要单篇长报告，应改用 timeline-report。

say.text: 给这个项目做 weekly digests，从第一周开始。
say.note: 先抓取完整时间线并按 ISO 周拆分。

say.text: 接着按周把 [项目] 的故事写下去。
say.note: 新一章会继承上一周的交接块。

say.text: 这个项目只有一周数据，也生成 digest。
say.note: 同一章同时写成起源与收尾。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude splits a project's claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week in sequence, each getting the prior week's carry-forward block, to produce one narrative chapter per week.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story" or "serial timeline" of a project's history. For one long sweeping report instead, use timeline-report.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for this project, starting from week one.
say_en.note: Fetches the full timeline and splits it by ISO week.

say_en.text: Continue the [project] story week by week.
say_en.note: Each new chapter inherits the prior carry-forward block.

say_en.text: This project only has one week of data — still make a digest.
say_en.note: That one chapter is both origin and close.
